stories.titlePinyin: Wǒ dāng māo de yì tiān
stories.summaryEnglish: A small white cat named Snow looks for food and finds a cozy bed.
stories.summaryChinese: 一只叫雪儿的小白猫找食物，找到了舒服的床。

stories.summaryEnglish: On a rainy morning, Xiaoyu discovers that a small kindness can warm two people.
stories.summaryChinese: 下雨的早上，小雨发现一个小小的好意可以温暖两个人。
